synthesis.body: lint-spec-status.py collects checklist items with `^##\s+Acceptance Criteria\b` and no re.IGNORECASE, so a spec whose heading reads `criteria` collects zero and invariant (ii) — every AC checked or deferred at the ship transition — passes vacuously forever. Eight specs in this repo are in that state and three more carry no criteria heading at all. Copy the heading from packs/core/.apm/skills/new-spec/assets/spec.md rather than typing it.

title: `## Acceptance criteria` is silently ungated — lint-spec-status matches case-sensitively
